pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, amoeboid-shaped regions with predominantly smooth, low-gradient edges. Spatial area of individual patches varies significantly across the flank, with some exhibiting star-like extensions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous, wide topological graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are thick with frequent three-way and four-way intersections. Pathway thickness is high relative to patch dimensions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck ridge, characterized by short, dark, uniform hair-bundle projections.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced diagonal shadow-casting from foreground foliage across the mid-flank, creating linear textural artifacts over the pelage pattern.
